description: Calculate Buyer's Stamp Duty (BSD) payable when buying property in Singapore, with the tier-by-tier breakdown. Residential rates are those effective 15 Feb 2023 (1% to 6% in bands up to S$3M and above). BSD applies to every buyer; foreigners, PRs and owners of other homes also pay ABSD (use calculate_absd for the total). From Propely (propely.sg), the owner-direct condo marketplace in Singapore. Indicative figures, not legal or financial advice.

price.description: Purchase price or market value, whichever is higher in Singapore dollars (SGD)
